proof_body:
by
  intro a y
  constructor
  · intro hy t
    have hg : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => y s * Real.exp (-(a * s))) 0 s := by
      intro s
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -(a * s)) (-(a * 1)) s :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul a).neg
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => y s * Real.exp (-(a * s)))
          (a * y s * Real.exp (-(a * s)) + y s * (Real.exp (-(a * s)) * (-(a * 1)))) s :=
        (hy s).mul h1.exp
      exact h2.congr_deriv (by ring)
    have hc : y t * Real.exp (-(a * t)) = y 0 * Real.exp (-(a * 0)) :=
      is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun s => (hg s).differentiableAt) (fun s => (hg s).deriv) t 0
    have hone : Real.exp (-(a * t)) * Real.exp (a * t) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    calc y t = y t * Real.exp (-(a * t)) * Real.exp (a * t) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, hone, mul_one]
      _ = y 0 * Real.exp (a * t) := by rw [hc]; simp
  · intro h t
    have hy : y = fun s => y 0 * Real.exp (a * s) := funext h
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => a * s) (a * 1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul a
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => y 0 * Real.exp (a * s))
        (y 0 * (Real.exp (a * t) * (a * 1))) t := h1.exp.const_mul (y 0)
    rw [h t, hy]
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h2
target_source: ∀ (a : ℝ) (y : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt y (a * y t) t) ↔ ∀ t, y t = y 0 * Real.exp (a * t)
